deploy-bot: Initiating staging deploy: tag=release/rc-2.0.0, commit=f9e8d7c, env=staging. Change window: maintenance-2026-03-22T03:00Z. Canary=3%. Release notes: https://docs.redwood.internal/releases/rc-2.0.0 (internal).

jen: On watch. Will keep the latency dashboards up and watch for client-error spikes.

rajesh: Kicking off smoke tests and DB migration dry-run (no-op flag set). Running: `./infra/migrate --env=staging --dry-run`

anya: Observability prechecks green. Alerting rule for model-timeouts enabled. ops-bot will auto-page on >=1% 5xx.

deploy-bot: Canary created on pool=alpha, nodes scaled to 6. Healthchecks: 15/15 passing.

jen: Canary 3% metrics: p50=40ms, p95=180ms, 5xx=0.2%. No red flags. :white_check_mark:

rajesh: Noticed slightly elevated cold-starts on worker-03 (~2s). Not enough to fail but logging it.

anya: Flipped config flag `reranker_lazy_load=false` for staging to smooth cold starts. Annotated runbook.

ops-bot: NOTE: automated stress scenario triggered at 10m mark for baseline comparison.

jen: After 10m under stress: p95 rose to 230ms but 5xx stayed <0.5%. Will continue to observe for 15m.

deploy-bot: Auto-roll forward scheduled. Pin command staged in case of rollback: `deployctl pin --env=staging --tag=release/rc-1.9.9 --reason="regressions"`

rajesh: If p95 > 300ms or 5xx > 2% sustained for 5m -> execute pin. Team agreed?

anya: Agreed. I'll escalate immediately if alerts fire.

jen: Ok shifting to 30% canary.

deploy-bot: Traffic shifted to 30%. Post-shift checks running.

jen: 30% metrics: p50=47ms, p95=260ms, 5xx=0.9%. Slight increase at tail but no error storm.

rajesh: Running targeted smoke on reranker; one pod logged an OOM-like spike but recovered. Investigating memory headroom.

anya: Given recovery and no error surge, continuing. Adding a note to release notes: "observed transient memory pressure on reranker under stress; mitigated by lazy-load flag."

deploy-bot: Final shift to 100% commencing. Will report completion when post-cut checks pass.

jen: Post-cut quick checks: API success rate 99.88%, latency within expected SLOs.

ops-bot: No active pages during watch window.

deploy-bot: STAGING DEPLOY COMPLETE — tag=release/rc-2.0.0, commit=f9e8d7c, duration=~20m, status=SUCCESS :tada:

rajesh: Saved pinned rollback command in clipboard just in case.

anya: Pushed final release notes and annotated changelog. Follow-up ticket created for reranker memory tuning: RH-3421.

jen: Watch window for 45m. If clear, we'll schedule promotion to dedicated canary next week.

ops-bot: Reminder: update post-deploy checklist in runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.internal/staging/6120001234
